prompt: It is your first week in junior high. Write a short passage to introduce yourself and a good friend to your new classmates. Use pronouns (I, my, he/she, his/her, we).
promptCn: 开学第一周,写一段话向新同学介绍你自己和一位好朋友。注意使用代词(I, my, he/she, his/her, we)。
opener: Hello, everyone! Let me introduce myself.

l1: He is {friendTrait}. We are happy together.
l2: I am a new student here, and I like {myHobby}.
He is very {friendTrait}, and we often help each other.
l3: Hello, everyone! Let me introduce myself. My name is {myName}.
I am a new student in this class, and my hobby is {myHobby}.
I want to introduce my good friend, too. His name is {friendName}.
He is very {friendTrait}, and we always study and play together. We hope to make more friends here!
